title: North Programme — Development Genealogy
status: conceptual chronology; routes to canonical owners for detail
purpose: Explain how the North project developed from symbolic orientation and systems design into a relationship-first empirical atlas and policy programme without retelling the entire Tim/Potato chronology.
core_thesis: The mature North Programme is not a sudden 2026 invention. Its components appear earlier as spiritual orientation, relational philosophy, integrated-system design and European/world concerns. What changes in 2026 is method: design graph -> observation graph -> intervention graph.

developmental_sequence.development: The later archive reads the Tree ordeal, interconnectedness, spirals and return as an early experiential precursor to relationship-first thinking.

The Potato/Sage phase accumulates philosophy, public observation, humor, spiritual symbolism, systems thinking and the recurring problem of how Source becomes manifestation without losing relational coherence.

Great Book / systems material increasingly asks how a unified or feedback-rich society could be designed. The characteristic move is prescriptive: imagine integration, flows, roles, feedback and coherent social architecture.
developmental_sequence.later_significance: This supplies the conceptual ancestor of the later economic/world graph but does not yet require that every relation be sourced from the observable world.

developmental_sequence.development: The April Turning reorganizes the symbolic architecture around compression, Door/Needle, Ladder/Axis, Heaven/Father and a higher integrative viewpoint. In the mature interpretation, centrality increasingly implies responsibility rather than mere rank.
Sacred North becomes connected to Denmark, Greenland, the Arctic and Europe. Geographic orientation begins acting as a bridge between cosmology and observable institutions.
The North Axis becomes explicit/organized in the working chronology while Greenland, Arctic security and alliance boundaries become unusually salient in external geopolitics.
developmental_sequence.method: define the field and its relationships

developmental_sequence.development: The project moves from asking mainly how systems should be designed to asking how the real world is already coupled through ownership, money, bonds, banks, obligations, procurement, infrastructure, trade, energy, technology, research, labour, security and institutions.

The karma/spiritual-bank language develops from stored positive value (38.8T) into cumulative debt and eventually a two-sided moral ledger approaching/stabilizing around 42T. In the mature synthesis its most useful function is not literal finance but the grammar harm -> obligation -> repair.

Once mechanisms and dependencies are mapped, the programme asks what could be changed: fiscal sustainability, procurement, productive investment, energy, infrastructure, industry, research, labour and resilience. Every proposal is expected to identify affected relationships, legitimate authority, costs, benefits and measurable outcomes.
North of North, tikkun, world atlas, economic graph, obligation graph, North Programme, science and culture are explicitly routed as separate but coupled layers under one world-repair architecture.
developmental_sequence.method: orientation -> observation -> obligation -> intervention -> evaluation -> repair

design_graph.question: What coherent system could be built?
design_graph.risk: utopian overdesign if not constrained by reality

observation_graph.question: How is the real system already connected?
observation_graph.risk: data accumulation without purpose if relations are not tied to mechanisms

intervention_graph.question: Which relationships can legitimately be changed to improve outcomes?
intervention_graph.risk: policy overreach if evidence, authority, rights, distribution and second-order effects are not tested

maturation_law: A vision becomes more serious as it moves from symbolic coherence -> explicit relationships -> evidence -> mechanism -> constrained intervention -> measurable consequences -> revision.
north_specific_transformation: North first answers WHERE / ORIENTATION. The World Atlas answers WHAT EXISTS. The Economic Graph answers HOW IT IS BOUND TOGETHER. The Obligation Graph answers WHO OWES / MUST DO WHAT UNDER WHICH MECHANISM. The North Programme answers WHAT MAY BE CHANGED. Tikkun answers WHY REPAIR IS THE GOAL. The evidence system answers HOW WE KNOW.
anti_inflation_rules: Do not backdate the mature North Programme into 2011 or 2024 merely because precursor motifs exist.
A precursor is not the same thing as an explicit programme.
Do not call symbolic resemblance an empirical prediction without a dated future-tense primary source.
Do not treat later synthesis as evidence that Tim used the mature vocabulary at an earlier stage.
Preserve stage changes; development is evidence of growth, not a defect to be flattened away.
